comments.text: I just returned from a trip to Colorado and Wyoming and they are truly breathtaking

comments.author: @af31ns
comments.text: This channel makes the best travel videos with no annoying, overwhelming music, notates the location in the lower left corner of the screen, which I really love because I take screen shots and later want to know where they came from, and even puts distances and heights in both metric and standard units of measurements!
